Ahri

the Nine-Tailed Fox

Ahri is a slippery mage with a reliable charm and three dashes on her ultimate. She can poke in lane, pick off a careless enemy, and dodge back out before anyone can punish her. A great choice if you want an assassin feel without the all-or-nothing risk.

When to pick Ahri

✓ Safe blind pick

Yes. Three dashes and a long-range Charm make her playable into almost any mid, so she's a great first pick.

Pick into

  • Immobile mages who can't escape a Charm, like Xerath, Vel'Koz and Ryze
  • Squishy backlines she can pick off with Charm + Spirit Rush, like Jinx or Lux
  • Teams that rely on dashes: Charm cancels them, so Yasuo or Kai'Sa get stopped mid-dash
  • Slow, grouped compositions where she can roam and find picks before fights start

Avoid into

  • Hard-hitting assassins who out-burst her, like Katarina and Diana
  • Very tanky teams with lots of health: she wants squishy targets
  • Teams with lots of point-and-click crowd control that pins her before she can dash, like Malzahar + Leona

Great teammates

ViVi's point-and-click ultimate locks a target so Ahri's Charm and combo can't miss.
NautilusNautilus hooks and roots, giving Ahri easy follow-up on roams to bot lane.
Jarvan IVJarvan IV's Cataclysm traps enemies so Ahri can unload her full damage.

Your team needs: Pick Ahri when your team has a frontline to start fights, so she can flank and finish the squishies they reveal.

How to read the enemy team → · Practice drafting →

Strengths

  • Spirit Rush gives three dashes, so she is very hard to catch and great at chasing
  • Charm cancels dashes and sets up kills for her whole team
  • Orb of Deception deals true damage on the way back, so it's strong even against tanky targets
  • Fast wave clear lets her push and roam

Weaknesses

  • If Charm misses, her all-in is much weaker
  • Short range compared to long-range mages, so she can be poked out of lane
  • Without her ultimate up she is far more vulnerable to ganks
  • Falls off against tanky teams if she doesn't find picks

Power spikes

  • Level 3: Q, W and E unlocked. Your first real trade window with the full combo.
  • Level 6: Spirit Rush makes you a kill threat and much safer from ganks.
  • First item (Malignance): more damage and a shorter ultimate cooldown. Start roaming.
  • Two items (Shadowflame): you can one-combo squishy carries in mid game fights.

Top tips

  • Land the return half of Orb of Deception: it deals true damage, which ignores magic resist.
  • Throw Charm after the enemy uses a dash or Flash. They have no way to dodge it then.
  • Use Fox-Fire's speed boost to dodge skill shots in lane, not just for damage.
  • Count your Spirit Rush casts. A takedown gives extra casts, so a kill can let you chain into a second target.
  • Ahri's short range means you should stand behind your minions until Charm is ready.
  • After a big Q on the wave, Essence Theft can heal you. Keep it in mind before you recall.
